notes.title: Have a chance to win a YUKI Statue!
notes.content:
Have you ever considered yourself lucky? This could be your chance to have an exclusive YUKI statue!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39076979/4155670a5990f7a8ee715bb4d81d5f7da26760c9.gif

We here at ARVORE partnered with Tesseract 3D, a top-quality 3D creator studio in Brazil, to bring Yuki to the physical world for the first time ever! The best part, we made it especially thinking of giving this unique statue away for a very lucky YUKI fan. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39076979/a502d6387d1f232b6bd308673c06854caa501f33.gif

YUKI is a game that we made with all our hearts. We dedicated lots of time creating a world that could communicate with our players in the best way possible. Ever since the early days of development, we noticed our community asking to have Yuki physically in their hands. Don't miss the opportunity to try your luck and have this awesome statue in your collection to celebrate YUKI and the holiday season.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39076979/ce8a75cbabbc9f5840605127799c35d7e6c467c1.gif

The statue is not for sale (at least not for now), so it's super exclusive! To participate you only need to go to our discord server and follow the steps in the #yuki-statue-giveaway channel to participate!

 ❗ GIVEAWAY ENDED ❗ 
This luck window has been closed already, but please feel free to join our discord server for future giveaways, discussions, and exclusive content about our games!

Good luck! 🤞

notes.title: Angle correction + Difficulty Balance + Quality of Life UPDATE
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39076979/390f676a635735faf04e41330dba4fec1f05e566.png

Hi, Space Rangers!
We made some adjustments to YUKI! Nothing major, but since our community was asking for them we decided to implement them already so everyone could enjoy our game the best way possible :)

Bugfixes

 Angle Offset correction for Vive and Index controllers
 Fixed a rare bug where no powerup choice showed up in the power capsule during the run

Quality of Life adjustments

 Added a skip button to allow users to bypass the intro screens
 Minor balancing improvements


We are always getting feedback and suggestions from our awesome community of players. Feel free to join our discord server to have a good chat, not to mention having access to some YUKI-related freebies and lore material ;)
https://discord.gg/AZ8fjvuzhc
